<!--
Project: Frailty Trajectories Before and After Incident Cancer in the
         Health Professionals Follow-up Study
Script:  3.2_exploratory_pre_design_model_eda.Rmd
Author:  Nemo Zhou
Date started:      2026-07-06
Date last updated: 2026-07-18 (availability grid and attrition diagnostics added)

Purpose:
  Produces a pre-design and pre-model exploratory analysis report for the
  overall incident cancer frailty trajectory question. The report builds a
  cohort flow table, describes frailty-index availability and missingness by
  4-year analytic cycle, compares baseline characteristics by eventual incident
  cancer status, plots crude frailty trajectories by calendar cycle, plots FI
  distributions by cycle, plots cancer-case frailty trajectories relative to
  cancer diagnosis, and summarizes death/dropout patterns.

Inputs:
  Data/FI_longitudinal_1986_2020_IMPUTED_Cancer.rds
    - Canonical longitudinal HPFS frailty-index dataset with cancer excluded
      from the FI score and with cancer timing/covariate fields.

Outputs:
  Results/cancer/data/3.2_cohort_flow.csv
  Results/cancer/data/3.2_fi_availability_by_cycle.csv
  Results/cancer/data/3.2_fi_availability_by_cycle_and_eventual_cancer.csv
  Results/cancer/data/3.2_baseline_characteristics_by_eventual_cancer.csv
  Results/cancer/data/3.2_crude_fi_by_calendar_cycle.csv
  Results/cancer/data/3.2_case_fi_relative_to_cancer.csv
  Results/cancer/data/3.2_death_dropout_by_cycle.csv
  Results/cancer/visuals/3.2_exploratory_pre_design_model_eda.html

Notes:
  The primary FI trajectory analyses use 4-year analytic cycles because some FI
  components are measured every 4 years. This exploratory report therefore uses
  cycles 1992, 1996, 2000, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, and 2020. Earlier 1986 and
  1988 FI observations are excluded from this report, and 1992 is treated as the
  descriptive baseline/reference cycle.
-->

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

project_dir <- "/Users/nemo/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-HarvardUniversity/Research/Frailty HPFS"
data_dir    <- file.path(project_dir, "Data")
results_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "Results", "cancer", "data")

raw_path <- file.path(data_dir, "FI_longitudinal_1986_2020_IMPUTED_Cancer.rds")

if (!dir.exists(results_dir)) dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if (!file.exists(raw_path)) stop("Canonical FI dataset not found: ", raw_path)

start_cycle <- "92"
start_year <- 1992
four_year_cycles <- c("92", "96", "00", "04", "08", "12", "16", "20")
cycle_lookup <- tibble(
  cycle = four_year_cycles,
  cycle_year = c(1992, 1996, 2000, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020)
)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
```

```{r helpers}
write_csv_base <- function(x, path) {
  utils::write.csv(x, path, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  invisible(x)
}

first_nonmissing <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA else x[1]
}

mean_sd <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  paste0(round(mean(x), digits), " (", round(stats::sd(x), digits), ")")
}

median_iqr <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  q <- stats::quantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), names = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  paste0(round(q[2], digits), " [", round(q[1], digits), ", ", round(q[3], digits), "]")
}

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return(NA_character_)
  if (p < 0.001) return("<0.001")
  sprintf("%.3f", p)
}

continuous_p <- function(x, group) {
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(group)
  x <- x[keep]
  group <- droplevels(factor(group[keep]))
  if (length(unique(group)) != 2 || length(x) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(stats::t.test(x ~ group)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

categorical_p <- function(x, group) {
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(group)
  x <- factor(x[keep])
  group <- droplevels(factor(group[keep]))
  if (length(unique(group)) != 2 || nlevels(x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  tab <- table(x, group)
  tryCatch({
    if (any(tab < 5)) stats::fisher.test(tab)$p.value else stats::chisq.test(tab)$p.value
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

summarize_continuous <- function(dat, var, label) {
  p <- continuous_p(dat[[var]], dat$eventual_cancer_status)
  dat %>%
    group_by(eventual_cancer_status) %>%
    summarize(
      Statistic = mean_sd(.data[[var]]),
      Median_IQR = median_iqr(.data[[var]]),
      Missing = sum(is.na(.data[[var]])),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = label,
      Level = NA_character_,
      P_Value = format_p(p)
    ) %>%
    select(Variable, Level, eventual_cancer_status, Statistic, Median_IQR, Missing, P_Value)
}

summarize_categorical <- function(dat, var, label) {
  p <- categorical_p(dat[[var]], dat$eventual_cancer_status)
  denom <- dat %>%
    group_by(eventual_cancer_status) %>%
    summarize(Denom = sum(!is.na(.data[[var]])), .groups = "drop")

  dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
    count(eventual_cancer_status, Level = .data[[var]], name = "n") %>%
    left_join(denom, by = "eventual_cancer_status") %>%
    mutate(
      Level = as.character(Level),
      Statistic = paste0(n, " (", round(100 * n / Denom, 1), "%)"),
      Median_IQR = NA_character_,
      Missing = NA_integer_,
      Variable = label,
      P_Value = format_p(p)
    ) %>%
    select(Variable, Level, eventual_cancer_status, Statistic, Median_IQR, Missing, P_Value)
}

```

# Load and Prepare Data

```{r load-data}
raw_fi <- readRDS(raw_path)

required_raw_cols <- c(
  "id", "cycle", "worked_rtmnyr", "rtmnyr86", "dbmy09", "fi_score_nocancer",
  "frailty_cat_nocancer", "age_at_cycle", "age_at_cancer", "cancer_date",
  "death_status", "dtdth"
)
missing_raw_cols <- setdiff(required_raw_cols, names(raw_fi))
if (length(missing_raw_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Canonical FI dataset is missing required columns: ",
       paste(missing_raw_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

panel_4yr <- raw_fi %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    cycle = as.character(cycle),
    worked_rtmnyr = as.numeric(worked_rtmnyr),
    rtmnyr86 = as.numeric(rtmnyr86),
    dbmy09 = as.numeric(dbmy09),
    cancer_date = as.numeric(cancer_date),
    dtdth = as.numeric(dtdth),
    fi_score_nocancer = as.numeric(fi_score_nocancer),
    age_at_cycle = as.numeric(age_at_cycle),
    age_at_cancer = as.numeric(age_at_cancer)
  ) %>%
  filter(cycle %in% four_year_cycles) %>%
  left_join(cycle_lookup, by = "cycle")

person_level <- panel_4yr %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarize(
    baseline_month = first_nonmissing(worked_rtmnyr[cycle == start_cycle]),
    birth_month = first_nonmissing(dbmy09),
    cancer_date = first_nonmissing(cancer_date),
    age_at_cancer = first_nonmissing(age_at_cancer),
    death_status = max(as.numeric(death_status), na.rm = TRUE),
    dtdth = first_nonmissing(dtdth),
    n_analytic_cycles = n_distinct(cycle),
    n_fi_observed = sum(!is.na(fi_score_nocancer)),
    has_baseline_row = any(cycle == start_cycle),
    has_baseline_fi = any(cycle == start_cycle & !is.na(fi_score_nocancer)),
    baseline_fi = first_nonmissing(fi_score_nocancer[cycle == start_cycle]),
    baseline_age = first_nonmissing(age_at_cycle[cycle == start_cycle]),
    baseline_frailty_cat = first_nonmissing(frailty_cat_nocancer[cycle == start_cycle]),
    baseline_smoke = first_nonmissing(smoke[cycle == start_cycle]),
    baseline_pckgr = first_nonmissing(pckgr[cycle == start_cycle]),
    baseline_bmi = first_nonmissing(bmi[cycle == start_cycle]),
    baseline_act = first_nonmissing(act[cycle == start_cycle]),
    baseline_race = first_nonmissing(race),
    baseline_marital = first_nonmissing(marital_status[cycle == start_cycle]),
    baseline_living = first_nonmissing(base_living),
    baseline_calor = first_nonmissing(base_calor),
    baseline_alco = first_nonmissing(base_alco),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    death_status = if_else(is.infinite(death_status), NA_real_, death_status),
    incident_cancer_after_baseline = !is.na(cancer_date) & !is.na(baseline_month) &
      cancer_date > baseline_month,
    prevalent_cancer_at_baseline = !is.na(cancer_date) & !is.na(baseline_month) &
      cancer_date <= baseline_month,
    eventual_cancer_status = if_else(
      incident_cancer_after_baseline,
      "Incident Cancer",
      "No Incident Cancer"
    ),
    eventual_cancer_status = factor(
      eventual_cancer_status,
      levels = c("No Incident Cancer", "Incident Cancer")
    ),
    died = death_status == 1
  )

eligible_persons <- person_level %>%
  filter(
    has_baseline_row,
    has_baseline_fi,
    !prevalent_cancer_at_baseline,
    n_fi_observed >= 2
  )

eligible_ids <- eligible_persons$id
panel_eligible <- panel_4yr %>%
  filter(id %in% eligible_ids) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("eventual_cancer_status", "incident_cancer_after_baseline",
                   "prevalent_cancer_at_baseline"))) %>%
  left_join(
    eligible_persons %>%
      select(id, eventual_cancer_status, incident_cancer_after_baseline,
             prevalent_cancer_at_baseline),
    by = "id"
  )
```

# Cohort Flow Table

```{r cohort-flow}
cohort_flow <- tibble(
  Step = c(
    "Participants in canonical longitudinal FI dataset",
    "Participants with 1992 baseline row",
    "Participants with nonmissing 1992 FI excluding cancer",
    "Participants cancer-free at 1992 baseline",
    "Participants with at least two observed 4-year-cycle FI scores"
  ),
  N = c(
    n_distinct(person_level$id),
    sum(person_level$has_baseline_row),
    sum(person_level$has_baseline_row & person_level$has_baseline_fi),
    sum(person_level$has_baseline_row & person_level$has_baseline_fi &
          !person_level$prevalent_cancer_at_baseline),
    nrow(eligible_persons)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Removed_From_Previous = c(NA_integer_, -diff(N)),
    Percent_Of_Initial = round(100 * N / first(N), 1)
  )

write_csv_base(cohort_flow, file.path(results_dir, "3.2_cohort_flow.csv"))
kable(cohort_flow)
```

# FI Availability and Missingness by Cycle

```{r fi-availability}
availability_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  id = eligible_ids,
  cycle_lookup
) %>%
  left_join(
    eligible_persons %>% select(id, eventual_cancer_status),
    by = "id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    panel_eligible %>%
      select(id, cycle, fi_score_nocancer, n_answered_nocancer),
    by = c("id", "cycle")
  )

fi_availability <- availability_grid %>%
  group_by(cycle, cycle_year) %>%
  summarize(
    n_eligible_participants = n_distinct(id),
    n_source_rows = sum(!is.na(n_answered_nocancer) | !is.na(fi_score_nocancer)),
    n_fi_observed = sum(!is.na(fi_score_nocancer)),
    n_fi_not_observed = sum(is.na(fi_score_nocancer)),
    percent_fi_not_observed = round(100 * n_fi_not_observed / n_eligible_participants, 2),
    mean_n_answered = round(mean(n_answered_nocancer, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median_n_answered = round(stats::median(n_answered_nocancer, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(cycle_year)

write_csv_base(fi_availability, file.path(results_dir, "3.2_fi_availability_by_cycle.csv"))
kable(fi_availability)

fi_availability_by_group <- availability_grid %>%
  group_by(eventual_cancer_status, cycle, cycle_year) %>%
  summarize(
    n_eligible_participants = n_distinct(id),
    n_fi_observed = sum(!is.na(fi_score_nocancer)),
    n_fi_not_observed = sum(is.na(fi_score_nocancer)),
    percent_fi_not_observed = round(100 * n_fi_not_observed / n_eligible_participants, 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(eventual_cancer_status, cycle_year)
write_csv_base(
  fi_availability_by_group,
  file.path(results_dir, "3.2_fi_availability_by_cycle_and_eventual_cancer.csv")
)
kable(fi_availability_by_group)

fi_availability_plot <- ggplot(fi_availability, aes(x = cycle_year)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = n_fi_observed), fill = "#3B6EA8", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_line(aes(y = n_fi_not_observed), color = "#B33A3A", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = n_fi_not_observed), color = "#B33A3A", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = fi_availability$cycle_year) +
  labs(
    x = "Questionnaire cycle",
    y = "Eligible participants",
    title = "FI availability and missingness by analytic cycle",
    subtitle = "Denominator is the 1992-eligible cohort; red line shows FI not observed"
  )

fi_availability_plot

```

# Baseline Characteristics by Eventual Cancer Status

```{r baseline-characteristics}
baseline_continuous <- c(
  baseline_age = "Age at baseline",
  baseline_fi = "Baseline FI excluding cancer",
  baseline_bmi = "BMI",
  baseline_act = "Physical activity",
  baseline_calor = "Total calories",
  baseline_alco = "Alcohol intake",
  age_at_cancer = "Age at cancer diagnosis"
)

baseline_categorical <- c(
  baseline_frailty_cat = "Baseline frailty category",
  baseline_smoke = "Smoking status",
  baseline_pckgr = "Pack-year category",
  baseline_race = "Race",
  baseline_marital = "Marital status",
  baseline_living = "Living arrangement",
  died = "Died during follow-up"
)

baseline_table <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(baseline_continuous), function(v) {
    summarize_continuous(eligible_persons, v, baseline_continuous[[v]])
  }),
  lapply(names(baseline_categorical), function(v) {
    summarize_categorical(eligible_persons, v, baseline_categorical[[v]])
  })
)

write_csv_base(
  baseline_table,
  file.path(results_dir, "3.2_baseline_characteristics_by_eventual_cancer.csv")
)
kable(head(baseline_table, 30))
```

# Crude FI Trajectories by Calendar Cycle

```{r calendar-trajectories}
calendar_fi <- panel_eligible %>%
  group_by(eventual_cancer_status, cycle, cycle_year) %>%
  summarize(
    n = sum(!is.na(fi_score_nocancer)),
    mean_fi = mean(fi_score_nocancer, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_fi = stats::sd(fi_score_nocancer, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_fi = sd_fi / sqrt(n),
    lcl = mean_fi - 1.96 * se_fi,
    ucl = mean_fi + 1.96 * se_fi,
    median_fi = stats::median(fi_score_nocancer, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(eventual_cancer_status, cycle_year)

write_csv_base(calendar_fi, file.path(results_dir, "3.2_crude_fi_by_calendar_cycle.csv"))
kable(calendar_fi)

calendar_fi_plot <- ggplot(
  calendar_fi,
  aes(x = cycle_year, y = mean_fi, color = eventual_cancer_status, fill = eventual_cancer_status)
) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = calendar_fi$cycle_year) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("No Incident Cancer" = "#2F6F5E", "Incident Cancer" = "#A9483B")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No Incident Cancer" = "#2F6F5E", "Incident Cancer" = "#A9483B")) +
  labs(
    x = "Questionnaire cycle",
    y = "Mean FI excluding cancer",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = "Crude frailty trajectories by calendar cycle",
    subtitle = "Grouped by eventual incident cancer status among participants cancer-free at baseline"
  )

calendar_fi_plot

```

    fill = NULL,

    subtitle = "Cycles begin in 1992; 1986 and 1988 FI observations are excluded"

# FI Trajectories Aligned to Cancer Diagnosis

```{r diagnosis-aligned-trajectories}
case_relative_fi <- panel_eligible %>%
  filter(eventual_cancer_status == "Incident Cancer", !is.na(years_to_cancer)) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_year_bin = round(years_to_cancer / 2) * 2
  ) %>%
  filter(rel_year_bin >= -20, rel_year_bin <= 20) %>%
  group_by(rel_year_bin) %>%
  summarize(
    n = sum(!is.na(fi_score_nocancer)),
    n_participants = n_distinct(id),
    mean_fi = mean(fi_score_nocancer, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_fi = stats::sd(fi_score_nocancer, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_fi = sd_fi / sqrt(n),
    lcl = mean_fi - 1.96 * se_fi,
    ucl = mean_fi + 1.96 * se_fi,
    median_fi = stats::median(fi_score_nocancer, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(rel_year_bin)

write_csv_base(case_relative_fi, file.path(results_dir, "3.2_case_fi_relative_to_cancer.csv"))
kable(case_relative_fi)

case_relative_plot <- ggplot(case_relative_fi, aes(x = rel_year_bin, y = mean_fi)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl), fill = "#A9483B", alpha = 0.18) +
  geom_line(color = "#A9483B", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#A9483B", size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray35") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-20, 20, by = 4)) +
  labs(
    x = "Years relative to cancer diagnosis",
    y = "Mean FI excluding cancer",
    title = "Crude FI trajectory among cancer cases",
    subtitle = "Cycle observations rounded to nearest 2-year relative-time bin"
  )

case_relative_plot

```

# Death and Dropout Patterns by Cancer Status

```{r death-dropout}
last_observed <- panel_eligible %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarize(
    last_cycle_year = max(cycle_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_cycle_month = max(worked_rtmnyr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

death_dropout_panel <- panel_eligible %>%
  left_join(last_observed, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(
    died_by_cycle = !is.na(dtdth) & !is.na(worked_rtmnyr) & dtdth <= worked_rtmnyr,
    last_observed_this_cycle = cycle_year == last_cycle_year,
    last_observed_alive_this_cycle = last_observed_this_cycle &
      (is.na(dtdth) | dtdth > last_cycle_month),
    last_observed_dead_this_cycle = last_observed_this_cycle &
      !is.na(dtdth) & dtdth <= last_cycle_month
  )

death_dropout_by_cycle <- death_dropout_panel %>%
  group_by(eventual_cancer_status, cycle, cycle_year) %>%
  summarize(
    n_observed = n_distinct(id),
    n_died_by_cycle = n_distinct(id[died_by_cycle]),
    percent_died_by_cycle = round(100 * n_died_by_cycle / n_observed, 2),
    n_last_observed_here = n_distinct(id[last_observed_this_cycle]),
    n_last_observed_alive_here = n_distinct(id[last_observed_alive_this_cycle]),
    n_last_observed_dead_here = n_distinct(id[last_observed_dead_this_cycle]),
    percent_last_observed_alive_here = round(100 * n_last_observed_alive_here / n_observed, 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(eventual_cancer_status, cycle_year)

write_csv_base(death_dropout_by_cycle, file.path(results_dir, "3.2_death_dropout_by_cycle.csv"))
kable(death_dropout_by_cycle)

death_dropout_long <- death_dropout_by_cycle %>%
  select(
    eventual_cancer_status,
    cycle_year,
    percent_died_by_cycle,
    percent_last_observed_alive_here
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("percent_"),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = recode(
      metric,
      percent_died_by_cycle = "Died by cycle",
      percent_last_observed_alive_here = "Last observed here while alive"
    )
  )

death_dropout_plot <- ggplot(
  death_dropout_long,
  aes(x = cycle_year, y = percent, color = eventual_cancer_status)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(death_dropout_long$cycle_year)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("No Incident Cancer" = "#2F6F5E", "Incident Cancer" = "#A9483B")) +
  labs(
    x = "Questionnaire cycle",
    y = "Percent",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Death and dropout patterns by eventual cancer status",
    subtitle = "Dropout proxy is final observed FI cycle while alive"
  )

death_dropout_plot

```
